description: The German Federal Waterways and Shipping Administration (WSV) publishes Inland ENC electronic navigational charts of the federal waterways on ELWIS, its electronic waterway information service. The charts are downloadable per waterway as ZIP archives in the official Inland ECDIS exchange format, compatible with Inland ECDIS standard 2.4, with a directory of available cells giving each cell's issue date and coverage. They can also be viewed as a free Web Map Service, and new or changed charts are announced through a news feed and the free ELWIS-Abo e-mail service. The WSV releases its geodata free of charge under the Geodata Access Act and the federal geodata use ordinance (GeoNutzV), which the page says requires no source note. ELWIS also carries navigation-relevant water levels, 4-day and probabilistic 14-day forecasts for Rhine gauges, 6-week forecasts for the Rhine, Elbe and Danube, a depth atlas, lock information and notices. Coverage: German federal inland waterways. Format and access: Inland ECDIS ZIP files and WMS, no registration. Licence and cost: free under GeoNutzV. Caveats: the charts need an Inland ECDIS application to display, which is not supplied, and the site is in German. It supports network flow models of inland navigation and exposure studies of fairways, locks and ports. It relates to the WSV WInD infrastructure data, PEGELONLINE water levels and the EuRIS fairway graphs in the catalogue.
